question: Show all pairs of entertainers and customers who each have up to three style strengths or preferences, where the first and second style preferences of the customers match the first and second style strengths of the entertainers (or in reverse order). Only return the entertainer’s stage name and the customer’s last name
sql:
WITH 
EntertainerStyles AS (
    SELECT 
        EntertainerID,
        StyleID,
        StyleStrength,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EntertainerID ORDER BY StyleStrength) as rank
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
),
EntertainerPairs AS (
    SELECT 
        e1.EntertainerID,
        e1.StyleID as FirstStyleID,
        e2.StyleID as SecondStyleID
    FROM EntertainerStyles e1
    JOIN EntertainerStyles e2 ON e1.EntertainerID = e2.EntertainerID
    WHERE e1.rank = 1 AND e2.rank = 2
),
CustomerPrefs AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        StyleID,
        PreferenceSeq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY PreferenceSeq) as rank
    FROM Musical_Preferences
),
CustomerPairs AS (
    SELECT 
        c1.CustomerID,
        c1.StyleID as FirstStyleID,
        c2.StyleID as SecondStyleID
    FROM CustomerPrefs c1
    JOIN CustomerPrefs c2 ON c1.CustomerID = c2.CustomerID
    WHERE c1.rank = 1 AND c2.rank = 2
),
Matches AS (
    SELECT 
        ep.EntertainerID,
        cp.CustomerID,
        'same' as match_type
    FROM EntertainerPairs ep
    JOIN CustomerPairs cp ON ep.FirstStyleID = cp.FirstStyleID AND ep.SecondStyleID = cp.SecondStyleID
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        ep.EntertainerID,
        cp.CustomerID,
        'reverse' as match_type
    FROM EntertainerPairs ep
    JOIN CustomerPairs cp ON ep.FirstStyleID = cp.SecondStyleID AND ep.SecondStyleID = cp.FirstStyleID
),
Results AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        e.EntStageName,
        c.CustLastName
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN EntertainerPairs ep ON m.EntertainerID = ep.EntertainerID
    JOIN CustomerPairs cp ON m.CustomerID = cp.CustomerID
    JOIN Entertainers e ON m.EntertainerID = e.EntertainerID
    JOIN Customers c ON m.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
)
SELECT * FROM Results ORDER BY EntStageName, CustLastName
